verses.1: Alas for their souls! When I seized them in my wrath, the Lord who sees all said: because their way is evil, and all who walk in the way of Satan the deceiver.
verses.2: And the way of the Lord they did not know, and they turned back after their own desires, and they transgressed the law.
verses.3: And I also will repay them according to the evil of their deeds in the latter time, on the day of judgment; I will requite them as it is written before me according to the evil of their deeds, and none shall escape from my hand, for I am the Lord, who kills and makes alive, who wounds and heals.
verses.4: And there is none who can escape from my hand, neither beneath the earth nor above the heavens, nor in the sea nor in the depths of the waters; for I am the Lord from one end of the world to the other, and every soul is in my hand.
verses.5: I also command what is beneath the earth, and the creatures that are in the sea, and the birds that are in the air, and the creeping things that are in the wilderness, from one end to the other and to the ends of the world; it is mine.
verses.6: And there is none who can escape from my hand, in heaven above or on earth below; for I am he who does wonders and marvels before my eyes, and there is none who says to me, Where are you going, and what are you doing?
verses.7: And I rule over the angels and the archangels, and every name that is named is mine, and all the birds of heaven and the beasts of the wilderness and the cattle are mine.
verses.8: And the south wind shall be raised up, and the heat of the west, and the Red Sea shall be dried up from the greatness of his majesty, for him who comes to it in the last days.
verses.9: For it is he who judges the living and the dead, together with Nubia and Sheba and Ethiopia and India, and all their borders and their boundaries.
verses.10: And he sees all things with his eyes, with the rod that is in his hand, and he sees with the rod of his rule; for his rod is exalted above all rods.
verses.11: And his horn is heavier than all horns, and his kingdom is exalted above all kingdoms, and his dominion holds the whole world; he is able to do all things, and there is none who can withstand him.
verses.12: He commands the clouds above, and he makes grass grow for the cattle below, and he gives fruit upon the field.
verses.13: And he gives drink to all as he wills, with its rain and with its fruit and with its drink, to all that he created: to the birds and the creeping things beneath the earth, and to the beasts and the cattle upon the earth; he who gives prayer to him who prays, and does not withhold their request from the orphans and the fatherless.
verses.14: And much more is the prayer of the pure accepted, who pray to him at all times; for the going up of the wicked is like a crooked wind, and the gathering of the violent is like a storm cloud.
verses.15: And their joy is like a fleeting bird, and the sight of them is like a passing shadow of gold and silver upon the earth; and their wealth does not remain with them, but it is a snare for the wicked, and the owner of their garments shall be eaten by worms.
verses.16: And the treasures of food and of grain shall be scattered by the wind and by the storm, and everything passes away like yesterday that has passed; and like a word that went out from the mouth and does not return, so is the wealth of sinners; and like a shadow that passes, so is their substance; and like a garment of moth, so is the wealth of sinners before God.
verses.17: But as for the righteous, God does not withhold their wealth from them; for while they teach the love of their wealth, and show mercy with justice to the fatherless and the poor, and while they clothe the naked from their garments, and while they do not withhold from the seed of their house what God has given them, so that they may give to the stranger and to the poor.
